description: This file defines an abstract GUI component class for Hono samplers within a JMeter plugin, providing layout and component management methods for customizing the UI.

classes.name: HonoSamplerUI
classes.description: Abstract class serving as a base for implementing GUI components for Hono samplers in JMeter, managing panel layout and component addition.

methods.name: HonoSamplerUI
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GUI layout, border, title panel, and options panel.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds a GUI component to the options panel, positioning it at the bottom.

methods.name: getLabelResource
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no specific label resource is provided.

methods.name: getWrapperPanelToFixAlignment
methods.description: Wraps a JLabeledChoice in a JPanel to fix alignment issues and adds layout adjustments.
